## For a superseded measurement

Every performance and signal figure quoted in this repository is supposed to be traceable to
`esm446-bench` or to a test, so that documentation and behaviour cannot drift apart. If a
quoted number no longer matches what the code produces, say which number, where it appears,
and what the current measurement is.
